title: Plan (input, contract v2)
description: A plan: the turns of a piece of work in order, each turn's stories, and each story's subagents, from which agentspace lease create picks a lease's size, and each turn's optional budget, from which it picks a plan lease's TTL. On the command line, --plan names a UTF-8 JSON file that holds this document, and --board with --epic reads it from the epic's agentspace-plan block on a localswim board; a create request's plan member holds it as an object, and lease-create.input.schema.json copies these $defs. Unknown members are refused everywhere. As in every input schema, null for an optional member (the plan's name, a turn's budget_minutes, a subagent's after) means it is not given, and null for a required member is refused. Names are compared exactly, never trimmed or case-folded; model and effort are recorded as given and read by no sizing. Anchored patterns end with $(?!\n), since $ alone matches before a final line feed in .NET and Python. What this schema cannot check, and the program checks (docs/lease-api.md, Values, Plan): a cycle in after, a subagent after itself included; an after entry that names no subagent of the same story; two turns of one name, two stories of one turn of one name, or two subagents of one story of one name; two members of one name in one object; a file larger than 262144 bytes, a byte order mark counted; a byte order mark anywhere but the file's start; a budget_minutes not written as digits alone, such as 90.0 or 9e1, which JSON Schema's integer accepts and the program refuses; and bytes that are not UTF-8.

plan.description: A plan document: an optional name, such as its epic's, and its turns in order.

name.description: The plan's name, printed as sized_for.plan. Null or absent means the plan has none.

turns.description: The plan's turns in order, 1 to 32.

plan_turn.description: A turn: its name, unique in the plan, its stories, which run at once, and its budget, if it has one.

budget_minutes.description: The turn's wall-clock budget in whole minutes, 1 to 960, from which a lease for this turn takes its TTL. Null or absent means the turn has none.

plan_story.description: A story: its name, unique in its turn, and its subagents. Its peak is counted from the subagents' after lists, never stated.

plan_subagent.description: A subagent: its name, unique in its story, its model and effort, and the subagents of the same story it starts after.

after.description: The names of the same story's subagents this one starts after, each once, at most 31. Null, absent or empty means it starts after none.

plan_name.description: A name in a plan, as given: 1 to 64 printable ASCII characters, not starting or ending with a space. Never trimmed or case-folded.

plan_model.description: A model, as given, such as Opus or Opus 5.5: 1 to 64 printable ASCII characters, not starting or ending with a space, as a name in a plan is. Never trimmed or case-folded, and never a list of names, so a new model needs no new version.

plan_effort.description: An effort, as given: 1 to 32 ASCII letters, digits, '.', '_' and '-', starting with a letter or digit. Never a list of names, so a new effort needs no new version.
